title: Research on Women's Federation Key Social Organizations' Participation in Community Services in the Paradigm of Cooperative Governance: A Case Study
abstract: Multi-subject co-governance is the direction of the development of social governance in China.Taking H family service center of D city,a Women's Federation key social organization in Guangdong,as an example,this paper analyses the cooperative effect of the key social organizations on the provision of community services,cultivation and hatching of social organizations,mobilization and integration of social resources and standardizing the development of social organizations from the micro perspective. The experience of H family service center shows that the institutional space of the key social organizations' effective participation in community services is the result of the selective transference of government functions and the embedded autonomous response from the key social organizations. The government should decentralize moderately to cultivate the institutional environment for key social organizations and key social organizations should initiatively seek development space,both of which could promote social collaborative governance in the process of positive interactions.
